name: say
description: Claude Code's voice, through murmur (Kokoro on the Apple Neural Engine): each session in its own voice (/say picks one), /say read and /say tldr, and $.voice.say for other mods; the notify mod decides what gets said

chime.title: Chime
chime.description: Play a soft chime before speaking

voice.title: Fixed voice
voice.description: One voice for every session (e.g. bf_emma). Empty: each session gets its own

voices.title: Session voices
voices.description: Comma-separated voices handed to sessions in order. Empty: the best-graded voice no other session has
